subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Ratchets: One Way Only
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ratchets: One Way Only.

hook.text: Click, click, click — a ratchet wrench turns a bolt without swinging back.

buildup.text: A pawl catches on saw-tooth notches, allowing motion in one direction only.

discovery.text: Flip the pawl direction and the ratchet reverses. Simple and reliable.

twist.text: Ratchets aren't just for wrenches. Zip ties are one-way ratchets too.

climax.text: Clocks, winches, and roller coaster lifts all use ratchet mechanisms.

punchline.text: One direction only — the ratchet's simple and powerful rule.

quiz.question: How does a ratchet mechanism work?
options: A pawl engages saw-tooth notches, allowing rotation in one direction only
Friction pads grip the shaft when it tries to reverse
A spring returns the handle but locks the output shaft
